rationale: The agent did identify the user via name and ZIP and pulled user details, which is a form of authentication. However, it proceeded to execute two exchange_delivered_order_items calls without first confirming the order-changing actions with the user, violating the explicit policy requirement to confirm before any write. It also used a stored payment method (PayPal) without confirmation. For the jigsaw, it selected a new item ID without demonstrating that it meets the user’s constraints (fancier theme, 500 fewer pieces, same difficulty) or providing supporting details from the tools. The final message provided no concrete exchange/return details or next steps. These issues mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
